questions.question_en: Over the past 2 weeks, how often have you felt little interest or pleasure in doing things?
questions.question_ms: Dalam 2 minggu lepas, berapa kerap anda berasa kurang minat atau keseronokan dalam melakukan sesuatu?
questions.question_zh: 在过去两周内，您多少时候做事时感到没有兴趣或乐趣？

questions.question_en: Over the past 2 weeks, how often have you felt down, depressed, or hopeless?
questions.question_ms: Berapa kerap anda berasa murung, tertekan, atau putus asa?
questions.question_zh: 您多少时候感到情绪低落、沮丧或绝望？

questions.question_en: How often have you had trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much?
questions.question_ms: Berapa kerap anda sukar tidur, sukar tidur lena, atau tidur terlalu lama?
questions.question_zh: 您多少时候难以入睡、保持睡眠，或睡得太多？

questions.question_en: How often have you felt tired or had little energy?
questions.question_ms: Berapa kerap anda berasa penat atau kurang tenaga?
questions.question_zh: 您多少时候感到疲倦或精力不足？

questions.question_en: How often have you had poor appetite or been overeating?
questions.question_ms: Berapa kerap anda kurang selera makan atau makan berlebihan?
questions.question_zh: 您多少时候食欲不振或暴饮暴食？

questions.question_en: How often have you felt bad about yourself — or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down?
questions.question_ms: Berapa kerap anda berasa tidak baik tentang diri sendiri — atau rasa gagal atau mengecewakan diri sendiri dan keluarga?
questions.question_zh: 您多少时候对自己感到不好——觉得自己是个失败者，或让自己和家人失望？

questions.question_en: How often have you had trouble concentrating on things, such as reading or watching television?
questions.question_ms: Berapa kerap anda sukar menumpukan perhatian pada sesuatu, seperti membaca atau menonton televisyen?
questions.question_zh: 您多少时候难以集中注意力，比如阅读报纸或看电视？

questions.question_en: How often have you been moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed? Or been so fidgety or restless that you moved around a lot more than usual?
questions.question_ms: Berapa kerap anda bergerak atau bercakap begitu perlahan sehingga orang lain mungkin perasan? Atau sebaliknya, begitu gelisah sehingga anda bergerak lebih banyak daripada biasa?
questions.question_zh: 您多少时候动作或说话缓慢到让别人注意到？或相反，太坐立不安，移动比平时多得多？

questions.question_en: How often have you had thoughts that you would be better off dead, or of hurting yourself in some way?
questions.question_ms: Berapa kerap anda terfikir bahawa anda lebih baik mati, atau mencederakan diri sendiri dengan cara tertentu?
questions.question_zh: 您多少时候有想死的念头，或想以某种方式伤害自己？
